item.title: Driving open research information forward: Why metadata enrichment matters for us at CWTS
item.description: The Centre for Science and Technology Studies (CWTS) at Leiden University recently joined the COMET Organizer group. In this post, CWTS researcher Nees Jan van Eck explains why CWTS is passionate about enriching metadata and participating in COMET.
